links.outcome: Accuracy of AI identification of post-cataract patients needing further review versus supervising ophthalmologist
links.effect: Overall outcome sensitivity 94%, specificity 86%; kappa 0.758-0.970 with clinicians. 4 patients discharged by Dora but not the clinician needed no review on callback.
links.quote: Dora R1 demonstrated an overall outcome sensitivity of 94% and specificity of 86% and showed moderate to strong agreement (kappa: 0.758-0.970) with clinicians in all parameters.

unlisted_practices: Real-time ophthalmologist supervision of an autonomous AI telemedicine call
Callback-based verification of AI discharge recommendations
Mixed-methods evaluation of patient acceptability and staff cost impact

screen.reason: Prospective clinical trial evaluating the safety, accuracy, and feasibility of an autonomous conversational AI agent (Dora R1) conducting post-cataract surgery telemedicine follow-up calls in real patients.
